article.title: Objeto directo en acusativo: ejemplos rusos
article.chapter: Acusativo y animacidad — Винительный падеж и одушевлённость

claims.summary: Cornell explicitly identifies direct-object function as one use of the accusative and lists verbs selecting accusative direct objects.
Он передал стакан, Он передал яйцо, and Он передал икру are Cornell’s examples of accusative direct objects across noun classes.
The three Russian sentences are reproduced from the source examples.
The article limits its claim to the stated function and attested sentences instead of universalizing case assignment.
